sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Fél (half) goes before the unit word, the same position as egy — fél kiló, fél liter — and doesn't change form.

items.english: I'd like half a kilo of tomatoes.
I'd like a bottle of sour cream.

sections.content: Fél kiló paradicsomot: fél stays fixed, kiló stays fixed, and only the final noun (paradicsomot) carries the accusative -t.
